navDesc.valueLists: What your forms remember: rename, merge and hide values

lists.writeHint: It is saved with this form and offered next time.
lists.adminsOnly: Only admins add new values to this list.
lists.loadFailed: The list could not be loaded.

x.rememberHint: Shows as a dropdown of what was typed before, most used first. The last choice is always “Write…”.
x.name: Name of the shared list
x.sharedHint: Every field that uses “{{name}}” offers and feeds the same list, in any form.
x.adminsOnlyHint: Once the list has values, everyone else can only pick. Admins add more here or in Masters → Lists.

p.adminsBody: Ask an admin to rename, merge or hide a value. You can still pick and write values in your forms.
p.emptyBody: Open a form in the builder, pick a text field and turn on “Remember what people type”. What people type there shows up here.
p.pickOne: Pick a list to see its values
p.notUsed: No form uses this list now
p.noValuesBody: Values appear here when people type them in a form. You can also add them yourself.
p.renameNote: Only what the list offers changes. Records that already say “{{value}}” keep saying it.
p.mergeNote: “{{value}}” leaves the list and its count is added to the one you keep. Records that already say “{{value}}” keep saying it.
p.mergeNone: There is no other value to merge into.
p.hid: “{{value}}” is hidden. Forms no longer offer it
